answer: New identities start on a ledge above the open market: they work only inside a tended garden pool for their first 40 jobs, and every result is mirrored to three independent auditors before it earns reputation, the way a tide is checked against the ocean floor. Entry costs a 110.000 POA bond, seized and burned in full on the first failed audit, plus a 13-epoch ban and loss of sponsor rights. Forging 1.000 fakes costs 1.000 x 110.000 = 110.000.000 POA, while an honest agent pays once and recovers the bond after probation. The limit is cold start: genuine newcomers wait longer for full access.
